prompts.dark_dragon: Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D game animation sprite sheet. Reference image shows the APPROVED SAME CHARACTER in several poses; preserve its exact design, palette, anatomy, facing direction and hand-painted colored-pencil ink texture. Create EXACTLY 12 sequential full-character poses, FOUR columns by THREE rows of equal square cells. Shared body scale and anchor in every frame, full silhouette visible with large transparent gutters. True transparent background, no scenery, ground, labels, borders, numbers, motion trails or extra characters. These are new animation in-betweens, not a redesign. The dark green horned DRAGON HEAD AND NECK faces RIGHT. Preserve this head-and-neck-only silhouette; no torso, legs or new wings. Ember eyes, ivory teeth, dark moss scales. Do NOT include the reference's long flame cone or rectangular flashes: real fire is drawn separately. Frames in reading order: 0 alert mouth closed; 1 chin draws back with jaw slightly open (inhale); 2 neck coils back, cheeks/throat fuller, jaw opening; 3 neck starts thrusting and jaw opens; 4 neck fully thrust forward, jaws wide open, ONLY a small warm light inside the mouth; 5 jaw starts closing with small head recoil; 6 neck relaxes halfway; 7 alert closed-mouth ready; 8 neck compresses low for a lunge; 9 head and neck reach dramatically forward for airborne lunge; 10 head pulls back/down into a landing brace; 11 tired head lowered, jaw loosely open. Keep horn and neck dimensions consistent.
